systems.name: 2.1 All 4 Unicorns & Stat Differentiation
systems.notes: Implement Nyx, Prism, Ember with unique stats and default weapons. Each must feel distinct in gameplay.
tasks: Nyx: high speed, low strength, Piercing Horn default
Ember: high special power, Blast Horn default
Character select screen with stat preview

systems.name: 2.2 Weapon System (All Horn Styles)
systems.notes: Implement all 5 horn weapons with unique attack patterns, range, and speed.
tasks: Broad Horn: wide arc, hits multiple enemies
Whip Horn: long reach, knockback, lower damage

systems.name: 2.3 Horn Powers (Special Abilities)
systems.notes: Full roster of horn powers: Prismatic Burst, Twilight Dash, Sunflare, Inferno Charge, Ethereal Pulse, plus variants.
tasks: Visual and audio feedback for each power

systems.name: 2.4 Passive Traits
systems.notes: Choose 1 per run. Momentum, Lifesteal, Reflect, Shared Fate, Endless Horn, Executioner.
tasks: Momentum: stack damage on consecutive hits, reset on damage

systems.name: 2.5 Cosmetic System
systems.notes: Mane styles, horn auras, coat colors, tail effects, armor overlays. Unlockable via Essence.
tasks: Define cosmetic slots and data structures
Create at least 3 mane variations per unicorn
